# Vendored draw.io viewer (moved)

The pinned viewer now lives, committed, at `services/engine/vendor/drawio/viewer-static.min.js`, with its hash, source and licence in
`services/engine/vendor/MANIFEST.json` (Apache-2.0, jgraph/drawio tag `v32.4.1`, SHA-256
`bc7586cb62eec98018c13b78619078d3a7179cc7bfc711c566dda19527520a30`, downloaded 2026-10-15 with the owner's approval).
The spike script takes its path as an argument: `node scripts/spikes/drawio_roundtrip.mjs FILE services/engine/vendor/drawio/viewer-static.min.js`.
